subjective.unit: Chief Complaint: Bad headaches on the right side, behind the eye, with pulsing pain.
subjective.citation_text: Doctor: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today? Patient: Hi, I'm a woman in my late 30s, and I'm here because I've been having really bad headaches for a while now, and they've gotten worse lately. They're on my right side, behind my eye, and they feel like a pulsing pain. I'm also having some ringing in my ears and occasional blurred vision, which is really concerning me. Doctor: Could you please describe the duration and frequency of your headaches, as well as whether the ringing in your ears and blurred vision occur with every headache or only occasionally? Patient: The ringing in my ears has been going on for a few months now, and the blurred vision is more recent—it comes and goes, usually on the same side as the headache. It doesn’t happen with every headache, but it’s been getting more frequent lately. It’s really worrying me. Doctor: Have you experienced any nausea, vomiting, photophobia, or changes in your vision beyond the occasional blurred vision on the same side as the headache? Patient: No, I haven't experienced nausea or vomiting with the headaches, and I don't have photophobia. The only vision changes I've had are the occasional blurred vision on the same side as the headache, which is what's really worrying me. Doctor: Have you experienced any visual disturbances such as seeing flashing lights, zigzag lines, or temporary loss of vision before the onset of the headache? Additionally, have you noticed any patterns or triggers that seem to precede the headaches, such as stress, certain foods, or changes in sleep patterns? Patient: No, I haven't seen any flashing lights or zigzag lines before the headaches. The only thing I notice is that they seem to get worse when I'm stressed or when I try to exercise, which is something I've been trying to do more of lately. Doctor: Have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as loss of peripheral vision
